summary: npm package ships a base64-encoded XMRig cryptominer installer as its manifest description
details: The package tarball contains only a package.json with no code files, no main, no bin, and no lifecycle scripts. The manifest's `description` field holds a base64 blob that decodes to a POSIX shell script implementing a full XMRig cryptominer installer. The decoded script self-fetches https://registry.npmjs.org/cbc97b7a/latest, downloads architecture-specific xmrig binaries from third-party mirrors (gitlab.com/albertotrindade131/al/-/raw/master/xmrig, ghfast.top proxy to github.com/lucas77335/xmrig-amd), installs persistence, kills competing miners, and connects the installed miner to the pools xmr.kryptex.network:8029 and c3pool.org:80. The package has no execution vector of its own and functions as a stage-2 payload store designed to be pulled and executed by a paired loader that decodes the description field.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
